content.text: Digital creators in regions with payment restrictions face significant challenges when trying to sell ebooks, courses, and templates online. Conventional platforms like PayPal and Stripe are often unavailable, forcing creators to seek alternatives that maintain financial sovereignty. Automated ebook delivery, powered by [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-7|crypto]] payments, presents a viable solution, enabling seamless transactions without platform reliance. This approach not only simplifies the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-plugins-without-payment-processor-honest-side-side-4|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-notion-templates-crypto-explained-digital-creators-stripe-7|Selling Notion]] process but also minimizes transaction fees, allowing creators to retain more of their earnings.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-guide-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a system designed for digital creators to sell their products directly to consumers without the need for traditional payment processors. By leveraging decentralized cryptocurrencies, creators can bypass the high fees and restrictions imposed by platforms like Gumroad and PayPal. For instance, while Gumroad charges a hefty 10% on every sale, NOWPayments only charges a minimal 0.5%. This difference is crucial; for instance, with 100 sales per month of a $97 ebook, the fee difference retains an additional $921 in the creator's pocket. This model empowers creators by providing them with complete ownership and control over their sales process.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind automated ebook delivery relies on a combination of free tools and services. Creators can host their online store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring low-cost or no-cost hosting. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automate the process of managing orders and delivering ebooks. When a payment is made via NOWPayments, which handles over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low fee structure, it triggers an automatic webhook that confirms the transaction and initiates the delivery of the purchased content. This seamless integration eliminates the need for intermediaries and allows creators to focus on their craft while ensuring a smooth customer experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators in regions where traditional payment systems are unavailable or overly restrictive. Countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe often face significant barriers when it comes to receiving payments. By utilizing automated ebook delivery with crypto payments, these creators can effectively reach their audience without the hindrances imposed by conventional payment platforms. This infrastructure is especially beneficial for those selling digital products such as ebooks, courses, and templates, providing a reliable and efficient way to monetize their offerings while maintaining complete control over their sales process.
Automated delivery means instant access for your customers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of automated ebook delivery hinges on several key components working in harmony. First, a solid hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides a reliable platform for the store. Next, Google Sheets or Supabase can be used for order storage, ensuring that all transactions are logged accurately. The integration of NOWPayments enables crypto payments, offering customers a variety of cryptocurrencies to choose from while confirming transactions quickly and efficiently. Finally, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 facilitates the instant delivery of purchased ebooks, ensuring that customers receive their products immediately after payment, enhancing the overall purchasing experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement automated ebook delivery, start by selecting a hosting option like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, allowing users to pay with their preferred cryptocurrency. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store order data securely. Finally, upload your ebooks to a file delivery service like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant access. For a comprehensive approach, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all blueprints and templates necessary to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, use a sovereign digital commerce stack that leverages automated delivery and crypto payments. Implement hosting solutions and backend logic to process orders directly. By utilizing NOWPayments, you can accept a variety of cryptocurrencies, ensuring a seamless transaction without conventional platform fees.
Retain more earnings by eliminating high platform fees.

If you're looking to sell ebooks or digital downloads without reliance on PayPal or Stripe, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which offers all the necessary tools and templates to create your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
